coverage_definition.definition: A symbolic definition exists; not proof of a deployed expert.
coverage_definition.partial: Some symbolic components exist; the complete requirement is not covered.
coverage_definition.missing: No sufficient existing skill contract is mapped.
coverage_definition.component: Historical planning/state/navigation components exist; not an executable skill contract in this release.

rows.name: Target grasp
rows.boundary: The legacy contract separates grasp and lift; confirm a combined off-surface terminal condition and avoid lifting twice.

rows.name: Placement and dropping
rows.boundary: Several placement/release contracts cover parts of this requirement; define stable placement, release, retreat and the held-object state on failure.

rows.name: Push one light object
rows.boundary: Generic pushing needs light-object mass, friction, target-region and hand-retreat contracts.

rows.name: Pull a light object by a handle
rows.boundary: Generic pulling does not include obtaining the handle, pulling into the region and releasing as one verified operation.

rows.name: Press a button
rows.boundary: Requires button localization, force/travel limits, trigger feedback and hand retreat.

rows.name: Toggle a switch
rows.boundary: Contact translation/rotation are components; switch positions, limits and switching effects require a dedicated contract.

rows.name: Adjust a knob
rows.boundary: Generic rotation does not establish knob operation; axis, scale, range and torque limits are required.

rows.name: Open or close a hinged door
rows.boundary: Specify hinge/handle, opening extent, latch and closure criteria; an openable scene label is not measured operability.

rows.name: Open or close a drawer
rows.boundary: Specify drawer axis, extent and closure criteria; a hinge trajectory is not interchangeable.

rows.name: Remove or replace a light lid
rows.boundary: Reuse pickup/placement components; lid-container pairing, alignment and the non-threaded scope remain to be defined.

rows.name: Unscrew or tighten a lid
rows.boundary: Threaded motion, stabilizing the second object, lid removal and tightening terminal conditions lack a complete contract.

rows.name: Gather scattered light objects
rows.boundary: Continuous sweeping, collection region, object set and completion criteria are missing.

rows.name: Spread a cloth
rows.boundary: wipe_surface assumes an already held cloth and does not unfold it; manual preparation must be an explicit input premise.

rows.name: Transfer between hands
rows.boundary: External-recipient handover is not an inter-hand transfer; two-hand occupancy and release need a contract.

rows.name: Pour with one hand
rows.boundary: Specify source/recipient containers, contents, amount, upright recovery and spill handling.

rows.name: Wipe a surface region
rows.boundary: Assumes an already held cloth; specify region/path and contact settings. Traversing a surface does not prove cleanliness.

rows.name: Align and stack
rows.boundary: Placement exists but stack alignment, stability and level-specific terminal state need a contract.

rows.name: Insert for storage
rows.boundary: Generic contact translation is not slot insertion; slot direction, clearance, contact/withdrawal and stable insertion criteria are required.

rows.name: Stabilize and pour with two hands
rows.boundary: Components exist but not a verified bimanual policy; resource sharing and coordinated execution cannot be inferred from a serial plan.

rows.name: Reset hand posture
rows.boundary: The generic reset does not fix the hand/gripper/arm scope; this requirement concerns fingers/wrist after empty-hand or stable-placement confirmation.

rows.name: Omnidirectional walking
rows.boundary: Requires velocity frame, duration/heartbeat and explicit stopping confirmation.

rows.name: Stepping turn
rows.boundary: Confirm angle units, error, translation drift and a stable final stance.

rows.name: Turn in place
rows.boundary: Clarify the distinction from a stepping turn and the permitted translation drift.

rows.name: Whole-body reach and grasp
rows.boundary: The reach/grasp contract does not prove body coordination, operating range or the off-surface terminal state.

rows.name: Whole-body reach and place
rows.boundary: The reach/place contract does not establish a crouch, body lean or return to standing.

rows.name: Bend and lift a box
rows.boundary: The symbolic lift/stand goal exists; actual mass, size, two-arm control and stable-stance contracts are external.

rows.name: Reset lower body
rows.boundary: Requires a standing reference state and held-object/support restrictions.

rows.name: Reset upper body
rows.boundary: Distinguish empty-hand and carrying recovery; do not assume object release.

rows.name: Controlled stop and stable stance
rows.boundary: Zero commanded velocity does not prove a stop; explicit stop, acknowledgment and stable-stance feedback are needed.

rows.name: Fine adjustment of manipulation stance
rows.boundary: Movement components do not establish fine stance adjustment; define frame, bounded displacement, accuracy and stable termination.

rows.name: Hold a low working posture
rows.boundary: Arm-height adjustment is not whole-body lowering and posture holding.

rows.name: Lower a box with both arms
rows.boundary: Single-hand/generic placement does not cover lowering a held box, two-arm disengagement and standing recovery.

rows.name: Walk carrying an object in one hand
rows.boundary: Holding plus navigation does not prove a carrying gait; requires an explicit mode and stability boundary.

rows.name: Walk carrying a box with both arms
rows.boundary: Lifting a box plus ordinary walking does not establish locomotion with visual occlusion.

rows.name: Coordinate pedal opening and dropping
rows.boundary: Requires coordinated pedal press/hold/drop/release and well-defined lid/held-object state on interruption.

rows.name: Push a box with whole-body coordination
rows.boundary: Tabletop pushing is not whole-body box pushing; contact, balance, load and disengagement contracts are needed.

rows.name: Pull a box with whole-body coordination
rows.boundary: Requires handle acquisition, backward stepping, whole-body balance and release.

rows.name: Whole-body supported manipulation
rows.boundary: Holding does not establish body support while the other hand works; concurrent resource contracts are needed.

rows.name: Recover balance after a small disturbance
rows.boundary: Specify disturbance limits, recovery and stop criteria; excludes standing up after a fall.

rows.name: Follow a reference path and avoid obstacles
rows.boundary: External navigation materials existed historically; the actual shared-framework path-following provider was not confirmed and is excluded here.

rows.name: Mapping and exploration
rows.boundary: Mapping produces state/resources; active exploration also needs planning/execution. Archived material is not an integrated mapping service.

rows.name: Instruction-grounded navigation
rows.boundary: Binding/navigation planning definitions exist; execution requires a verified frame/map version and carrying mode. Do not send an object center as a ready-to-execute goal.

rows.name: Search navigation
rows.boundary: Query/route/observation components do not establish a complete search loop; budget, not-found and duplicate-target contracts are needed.

rows.name: Ordered multi-stop scheduling
rows.boundary: Room-recursive visit/memory components existed historically; resumption needs verified execution effects in the shared framework.

rows.name: Select a manipulation stance
rows.boundary: Historical geometric candidate-point filtering did not prove target orientation, manipulator reach or whole-body clearance; it is excluded from this release.

rows.name: Replan after obstruction
rows.boundary: Requires original obstruction feedback, map changes and evidence that an obstacle may be moved; this is not a replacement for local avoidance.

rows.name: Acquire an additional observation
rows.boundary: Observation querying may be reused; viewpoint changes need an actual provider. An image alone does not establish an action effect.

rows.name: Inspection patrol
rows.boundary: Visit/logging components do not establish patrol normal/abnormal/unknown criteria or a verification interface.

limitations: Coverage is a symbolic contract assessment, not measured robot capability.
Partial/component mappings must not be treated as equivalent executable skills.
This release excludes external navigation providers and robot deployment.
